notes.title: 🚀 New project on Kickstarter! Residual Wilds is now live
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][b]Hello everyone![/b]
We’re very excited to announce that our new game [b]Residual Wilds[/b] is now live on Kickstarter! This project is very special to us, and your support can help us make it a reality. Whether you pledge, share the campaign, or simply follow it, every bit of help makes a difference.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147477/093154c7da47bdb94c39bb9dc12e2ba0f72d01a8.png"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Campaign Rewards[/b]
The following rewards are available [b]exclusively during this Kickstarter[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]🗝️ Steam Key – Full digital game[/p][/*][*][p]💻 Exclusive HD wallpapers (PC only)[/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ Small mousepad – 8.7" x 7.1"[/p][/*][*][p]🖱️ XL mousepad – 36" x 18"[/p][/*][*][p]👕 Official Residual Wilds T-shirt[/p][/*][*][p]🧥 Official Residual Wilds hoodie[/p][/*][*][p]🔫 Personalized in-game weapon design[/p][/*][*][p]👾 Personalized in-game enemy design[/p][/*][*][p]🗨️ Personalized in-game NPC creation with custom dialogues[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45147477/1bf9b66021b63f271d1e2237f45e93088831bd12.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Support for the Kickstarter campaign continues to grow every day.[/p][/*][*][p]We’re getting closer to the [b]second stretch goal reward[/b] — new content coming soon![/p][/*][*][p]Throughout the campaign, we’ll share new concept art and small gameplay previews to show progress.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][b]How to Support[/b]
Join the campaign here:
[/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/magicarthat/residual-wilds"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/magicarthat/residual-wilds[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Share the link with friends, communities, and gamers who might enjoy the project.[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Contact[/b]
If you have any questions about tiers or rewards, contact me via Kickstarter messages or email at [/p][p][url="https://magic.art.hat.supp@gmail.com"]magic.art.hat.supp@gmail.com[/url][/p][p][/p]
